output: SELECT SUM(qty) FROM inventory;

instruction:

Minimum qty
output: SELECT MIN(qty) FROM inventory;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Row count
output: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Count distinct values of product_id
output: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM inventory;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Total qty per product_id
output: SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Average qty per product_id
output: SELECT product_id, AVG(qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Maximum qty per product_id
output: SELECT product_id, MAX(qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
product_id with total qty above 1000
output: SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id HAVING SUM(qty) > 1000;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
product_id groups having more than 5 records
output: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Count records per product_id
output: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Total qty grouped by product_id ordered by total desc
output: SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS tot FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY tot DESC;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Minimum qty per product_id
output: SELECT product_id, MIN(qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Average qty where qty > 0
output: SELECT AVG(qty) FROM inventory WHERE qty > 0;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Total qty for records after 2024
output: SELECT SUM(qty) FROM inventory;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Rollup of product_id with totals
output: SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY ROLLUP(product_id);

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Cube of product_id with totals
output: SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY CUBE(product_id);

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Standard deviation of qty
output: SELECT STDDEV(qty) FROM inventory;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Variance of qty
output: SELECT VARIANCE(qty) FROM inventory;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Total qty for each product_id having at least 2 rows
output: SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Median of qty per product_id
output: SELECT product_id, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY qty) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Sum and count combined per product_id
output: SELECT product_id, SUM(qty), COUNT(*) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Grouping by two columns product_id and qty
output: SELECT product_id, qty, COUNT(*) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id, qty;

instruction:
Schema: inventory(id, product_id, qty, wh)
Number of distinct wh per product_id
output: SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT wh) FROM inventory GROUP BY product_id;
